name: How long does it take to seal windows to prevent cold air drafts?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to seal windows to prevent cold air drafts?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required to seal windows depends on the method and the number of windows. Temporary solutions like applying window film or rope caulk might take 15-30 minutes per window for a DIY approach. Professional sealing or recaulking of existing windows can take a few hours to a full day, depending on the scope. If the issue requires full window replacement, the process can span several days for multiple windows, including removal, installation, and finishing work. A contractor can provide a more precise estimate.
